packages.title: Religious Kathmandu
packages.description: Explore Nepal's two major religious traditions at Pashupatinath Temple and Boudhanath Stupa, and see how faith shapes daily life, from life and death to philosophy.
highlights: Pashupatinath, the most revered Hindu temple in Nepal
Photos with sadhus and an optional palm reading
Optional observation of Hindu cremation rituals
Walk around Boudhanath Stupa and its Tibet-like market
Monastery visit and a chat with monks if they are free
Buddhist philosophy briefing from your guide
itinerary: Meet at the crossroad by Employee Provident Fund, Tridevi Marga, and take a taxi to Pashupatinath Temple
Sightseeing at Pashupatinath, with an optional palmist consultation
Walk along the Bagmati River up to Slesmantak holy forest for a better view of the temple
Drive to Boudhanath Stupa, walk around it and visit the monasteries
Brief chat with monks if the situation favors
Observe the stupa from a nearby monastery
Drive back to Thamel
inclusions: Entry fees to Pashupatinath Temple and Boudhanath Stupa
A drive from the starting point to the end point of the trip
exclusions: Personal expenses
Palmist's fee if you wish to consult one
Any food or drinks during the trip
Tips and gratitude
Anything not included in the inclusions

packages.title: Kathmandu Time Travel: Patan and Bhaktapur
packages.description: Walk through alleys that are centuries old, courtyards of former royal palaces and living workshops in Bhaktapur and Patan, two towns that have defied the decay of time.
highlights: Bhaktapur's four squares: Durbar, Taumadhi, Dattatreya and Pottery
Narrow, photogenic alleys lined with old buildings
Locals at daily work: drying grain, weaving, painting thanka, making pottery
Swarnabarna Mahabihar (Golden Temple) in Patan
Stone work at Kumari Chok and the 1667 Krishna Temple
Newari architecture and the story behind Kathmandu's name 'city of temples'
inclusions: Entry fees to Bhaktapur Durbar Square and Patan Durbar Square
A drive from the starting point to the end point of the trip
exclusions: Personal expenses
Any food or drinks during the trip
Tips and gratitude
Anything not included in the inclusions

packages.title: Living 15th Century in Bhaktapur
packages.description: Pottery, sightseeing and lunch in Bhaktapur, the medieval city that kept its monuments and its everyday culture intact. Live a day the way local people do.
highlights: Pick fresh vegetables at the local market
Prepare and enjoy a Newari lunch
Walk the old Newari alleys and settlements
Try your hand at pottery in Pottery Square and make your own memento

packages.title: Kirtipur Cultural Walk and Local Aila
Live a Day Like a Nepali
packages.description: An early morning walk along Ason, a hike to Swayambhu and lunch in a Nepali kitchen.

packages.title: Nagarkot to Changu Narayan Hike
packages.description: A one-day combo of nature, culture and adventure: sunrise at Nagarkot, a downhill walk through Tamang villages and forest, and the ancient Changu Narayan temple.
highlights: Sunrise over the Himalayas from Nagarkot (2,135 m)
About 14 km, 4 to 5 hours, mostly downhill
Tamang village life and the Telkot community forest
Changu Narayan, one of the oldest Vishnu temples in Nepal, home to the oldest inscription found in Nepal
Old Newari culture and handicraft shops on the cobbled path up to the temple
itinerary: Early hotel pickup and a drive to Nagarkot
Short hike to the viewpoint for sunrise, then a quick breakfast
Downhill walk through a Tamang village to Telkot (about 7 km)
Gradual climb through Telkot community forest (about 7 km to Changu Narayan)
Lunch break in Changu Narayan village
10-minute uphill stroll to the temple and free time to explore
Walk back to the car and drive to Kathmandu
inclusions: A drive from the starting point to the end point of the trip
exclusions: Personal expenses

packages.title: Ghandruk Poon Hill Trek
packages.description: A short trek that combines landscape, vegetation and people, ending at Poon Hill (3,210 m) for a 360-degree mountain view. Ideal if you have limited time and want to avoid the risk of altitude sickness.
highlights: Sunrise from Poon Hill with a 360-degree view of Dhaulagiri and the Annapurna range
Rhododendron forest
Ghandruk, a traditional Gurung village with museums and Gurung dress to try
Fast option: complete it in 3 days
itinerary: Day 1: Pokhara to Nayapul by drive, then trek to Ulleri (850 m to 1,950 m, 5-6 hours)
Day 2: Ulleri to Ghorepani (1,960 m to 2,860 m, 4-5 hours)
Day 3: Poon Hill sunrise, then Ghorepani to Tadapani via Deurali Pass
Day 4: Tadapani to Ghandruk (2,630 m to 1,940 m, 3-4 hours)
Day 5: Jeep from near Ghandruk, or walk down to Birethanti and Nayapul
inclusions: Services of an experienced leader and porter
Two-way transport from and to Kathmandu
National park and conservation area fees
exclusions: Personal expenses
Insurance
Tips and gratitude to the guide and porters
Anything not included in the inclusions

packages.title: Everest Base Camp Trek
packages.description: Not just a trek but a source of pride. View six of the 14 tallest peaks up close, live with the Sherpa community and push your limit, one mindful step at a time.
highlights: Himalayan views on the flight from Kathmandu to Lukla
Landing at one of the world's most dangerous airports
Life with the Sherpa community
Photos with yaks and zhopkyos, the trucks of the Himalayas
Some of the highest settlements in the world
Standing at the base of Mount Everest
360-degree views of snow-capped peaks
Musk deer, Himalayan goats (ghoral) and colorful Himalayan pheasants
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Kathmandu
Day 2: Flight to Lukla
Day 3-13: Trek to Everest Base Camp and back
Day 14: Return to Kathmandu
inclusions: Services of an experienced leader and porter

Hot springs at Tatopani

packages.title: Pokhara
packages.description: Pokhara is the brand of many experiences, from adventure sports and caves to museums, temples and the gateway to Nepal's great trekking trails, all under views of the Annapurna range.
highlights: Paragliding, boating, kayaking, heli tour, ultra flight and bungee jump
Cave walking: Gupteshwor, Mahendra and Bat caves
Museums: International Mountain Museum, Gorkha Museum and Butterfly Museum
Sunrise trip, hikes, temples and stupas, gorges and waterfalls
Views of Dhaulagiri, Nilgiri, Annapurna I, Himchuli, Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Mardi Himal, Lamjung Himal and Manaslu

packages.title: Chitwan
packages.description: Explore Chitwan's lush jungle on foot, by jeep or by canoe. Spot one-horned rhinos, deer and exotic birds while you drift through untouched wilderness.
highlights: One-horned rhino spotting
Jungle safari by jeep
Canoe ride on the Rapti River
Tharu cultural program
itinerary: Day 1: Drive to Chitwan
Day 2: Full day jungle activities
Day 3: Morning safari and return
